name: io.github.1shizaan/debugai-mcp
description: MCP server for DebugAI. Browser sign-in, auto client setup, no key pasting.

environmentVariables.description: Optional. API base URL, for a staging or self-hosted setup. Defaults to DebugAI production.
environmentVariables.name: DEBUGAI_API_BASE

environmentVariables.description: Optional. Deadline in milliseconds for a debug_error call. Defaults to 150000.
environmentVariables.name: DEBUGAI_TIMEOUT_MS

environmentVariables.description: Optional. Alternate location for the config file that holds the stored key. Defaults to ~/.debugai/config.json.
environmentVariables.name: DEBUGAI_CONFIG_PATH
